chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Hasan ibn Mahboub, from Abu Wallad Al-Hannat, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

I heard him (peace be upon him) saying: No one shall be given less than five dirhams from the zakat, and it is the least amount that Allah, Exalted and Majestic, prescribed for the zakat in the wealth of the Muslims. Therefore, do not give anyone from the zakat less than five dirhams, and upwards.
ai.seo_question: What is the minimum amount of zakat that can be given to a single recipient according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi specifies the minimum distribution amount (niṣāb al-ʿāṣim) for zakat recipients as five dirhams, a ruling derived by scholars from the Quranic verse 9:60. It ensures that the administrative burden of distribution does not outweigh the benefit to the poor, reflecting the Shia juristic emphasis on practical welfare and the sanctity of the prescribed minimums.
